subject: POC trial planning: success criteria, timeline & exec readout
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@veridianbio.com>, Priya Singh <priya@veridianbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, May 1, 2027 at 9:15 AM PDT
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed PoC plan (draft attached)

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan going into the trial: 

Summary / goal:
- Run a 2‑week PoC to validate Redwood inference for Veridian Bio's clinical note summarization workflow. Primary objective is to confirm latency, cost per 1k tokens, and extraction accuracy on a 10k‑sample corpus.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end‑to‑end inference <= 300ms for <1k tokens.
2) Quality: Entity extraction F1 >= 0.87 against your labeled set.
3) Reliability: >= 99% successful responses (no timeouts) during peak workload.
4) Integration: API integration and sample pipeline end‑to‑end run with your test dataset.

Timeline (proposed):
- May 6: deliver anonymized sample dataset and API test accounts from Veridian (Priya)
- May 10: PoC kickoff, backend access & initial run
- Weekly syncs: Wednesdays 10:00 AM PT (May 12, May 19)
- May 24: Final readout + exec decision (Go/No‑Go) — propose 10:00 AM PT; request Tom Keller (CFO) if procurement decision required

Owners / responsibilities:
- Veridian: Priya (Product) owns dataset + labeling clarifications; Tom (Finance) for procurement questions
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) overall program owner; Marcus (SE) technical lead (integration, SLO validation); Rishi (Sales) exec sponsor

Please review the attached PoC plan (redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf) — it has a proposed test matrix, evaluation checklist, and access steps. Reply with any edits to success criteria or schedule by EOW (May 3) so we can lock the kickoff.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and much appreciated for the clear plan. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Confirmed success criteria with one tweak: please add an integration test pass (end‑to‑end pipeline run with our de‑identified EMR export) as a hard gate.
- Latency: 300ms 95th p is fine as a target; can we also capture median for reporting?
- Owners: Priya will own dataset delivery (I'll loop Tom on the readout invite).
- Timeline: May 6 dataset delivery is OK; kickoff May 10 works.

We can commit to the May 24 readout at 10:00 AM PT. Tom will try to join but if he can't, we'll send a proxy.

Liam

Subject: Re: PoC technical plan & eval approach

Thanks Priya — noted on dataset delivery. A few technical notes and the eval plan so expectations are clear: 

Evaluation plan (high level):
- Ingestion & sanity checks (Day 0–1): schema validation, tokenization checks, and sample size confirmation.
- Baseline run (Day 2–3): run Redwood pipeline to collect latency, token counts, and quality metrics on 1k sample set.
- Iteration (Day 4–10): parameter tuning (prompt templates, batching, quantization profile) to hit latency and cost targets while preserving quality.
- Final run (Day 11–13): 10k sample evaluation to produce final metrics for readout.

Ownership: Marcus (SE) will own the run and produce the metrics dashboard. I'll set up test accounts and a lightweight Jenkins job to run the batch and export CSVs. Weekly syncs will be Wednesday 10:00 AM PT — I'll put calendar invites for May 12 and May 19.

Pre-reads for Tom: Rishi / Marissa — we can prepare a 1‑pager pricing & commitment memo. Recommend sharing by May 17 so Tom has time to review before May 24.

--Marcus
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
